embedded-family-documents.label: Embedded family documents (save units)
embedded-family-documents.description: each embedded save unit 1..k is a complete family DOCUMENT (an .rfa) stored inside the project

loadable-families.label: Loadable families (host side)
loadable-families.description: Family / FamilySurrogate / FamSymSurrogate — the host records for loaded .rfa content

family-types-symbols.label: Family types (symbols)
family-types-symbols.description: FamilySymbol and Symbol descendants of model categories — the placeable types

system-family-types.label: System-family types
system-family-types.description: wall / floor / roof / ceiling / duct / pipe / conduit / cable-tray types, curtain systems, stairs / railing types (HostObjAttr + *Type)

ours-created.name: GEN Roof - Concrete Deck 200mm with Insulation

views-and-templates.label: Views & view templates
views-and-templates.description: views, view templates, sheets, viewports, schedules, browser organization

object-styles.label: Object styles (categories / graphics styles)
object-styles.description: CategoryElem, GStyleElem, ModelGraphicsStyle — subcategories and their graphics

patterns-materials.label: Fill / line patterns, materials, appearance assets
patterns-materials.description: FillPatternElem, LinePatternElem, MaterialElem, AppearanceAssetElem, tile / conceptual types, fonts, pen tables

text-dimension-types.label: Text / dimension / arrowhead / annotation types
text-dimension-types.description: TextNoteAttributes, DimensionStyle, LeaderStyle (arrowheads), FilledRegionAttributes, spot / section / callout styles

Section Head - No Arrow, Section Tail - Filled Horizontal

annotation-symbols-titleblocks.label: Annotation symbols & title blocks
annotation-symbols-titleblocks.description: family symbols / families in annotation categories: tags, title blocks, generic annotation, heads, view titles

project-info-settings.label: Project info & settings elements
project-info-settings.description: ProjectInfo, UnitsElem, keynote table, ElectricalSetting, all *Settings singletons

mep-electrical-definitions.label: MEP / electrical definition tables
mep-electrical-definitions.description: voltage & distribution-system types, demand factors, load classifications, wire / pipe / duct material tables, panel schedule templates

datums.label: Datums (levels / grids / reference planes)
datums.description: Level, Grid, RefPlane, extents — near-trivial numeric definitions (reported, not gated)

placed-model-content.label: Placed model content (sample geometry)
placed-model-content.description: instances, walls, floors, ceilings, MEP curves, rooms/spaces/zones, circuits, rebar, loads — the sample's model

view-annotation-2d-content.label: View-owned 2D / annotation content
view-annotation-2d-content.description: detail lines, text notes, dimensions, tags, filled regions, sketches, legend components

internal-bookkeeping.label: Internal bookkeeping (regenerated by Revit)
internal-bookkeeping.description: trackers, hubs, regen splitters, warnings, caches — machine state, not expression
